verification.source: Official scene page and its Embed control, observed through the in-app browser
verification.visual: Loaded live viewer shows the blue plush star, black beret, glossy oval eyes and dense fine curled fur corresponding to the user-supplied reference screenshot
verification.interaction: Official orbit button was selected, then a horizontal drag visibly changed the 3D view from front to side
verification.download: The official Download control displayed: Please log in to download this splat. No asset file was downloaded and no login was performed.
verification.localIntegration: Local reference-plush.html actually rendered the original fine curled plush scene in the Codex in-app browser. Outer fullscreen entry and Escape exit verified. Screenshot: cycles-study/reference-original-local-fullscreen.jpg. Orbit, zoom and reset were verified in the official direct viewer; local iframe pointer automation was limited by fractional coordinate routing, so local drag verification is not claimed.
